original_sentence: Adherence to these principles, along with a commitment to truthful dialogue, can help every student better appreciate how far we've come and more clearly see the roads we have yet to travel.
translation: 坚持这些原则，并承诺开展真实对话，能够帮助每个学生更好地理解我们已经走了多远，也更清楚地看到我们仍需走过的道路。
